access_index.small_sources: all source_files roles in portable package; read-only, SHA-256 checked

license_access.dual_sphysics: provenance/source metadata only; no solver execution in replay worker
license_access.redistribution: not a public release; caller must use existing authorized source paths and license

migration.allowed: path_map may move all sources and request together; source SHA-256 must match after relocation
migration.hdf5: HDF5 is producer-attested only; relocation requires bytes+mtime check and producer SHA, no content hash is asserted by this package
migration.license: no solver binaries, license files, or native data are copied into this package; caller must have authorized read access
migration.stat_policy: small source hashes are authoritative; old absolute paths and mtime are not used as portable identity
migration.wrong_content: same-size wrong-content and wrong-case files must be rejected by SHA/role checks

reader.hdf5_policy: only bound trajectory.h5, selected all-fluid cohort, exact frame 0..400; io_slot_approved=True is mandatory
reader.identity: (Zone,Idp), initial type_code=3, MK codes 1/2/3, source box, expected 21114
reader.mass_policy: frozen initial particle mass; initial denominator 21.114001002861187 kg; later missing 0.003000000142492354 kg is unknown bucket

runtime.cpu: one CPU core guard slot; no model/CFD
runtime.memory: request cap 1024 MiB; preallocated selected-fluid float32 arrays; primary guard measures RSS
